test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All pigeons are doves.

All doves are mynas.

**Conclusions:**

I. All mynas are pigeons.

II. All pigeons are mynas.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
**Explanation:**

The possible venn daigram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d81bcc4b8da59077b0da638560784d780c519cf9b92b8e6041627bb9657faa4b.png] 

conclusions:

I. All mynas are pigeons. - False (There is no definite relation between mynas and pigeons. Hence, false)

II.All pigeons are mynas. - True (As, all pigeon are mynas as shown above in venn diagram)

Hence,** Only conclusion II follows** is the** correct answer.**
